text.p: The following stocks are active in Friday equity trading.

-- The company Thursday said it will report a small loss in the third quarter vs a profit of $0.17 a share before an extraordinary item in the year ago quarter. First Call estimated a third quarter profit of $0.15 a share.
Coleman said it expects to resume normal earnings in the fourth quarter, excluding the expected dilutive effect of Camping Gaz, which will cause a small reported loss.
The company also said it will take one time, after tax, charges in the third and fourth quarters totaling about $50 million.
-- Belo agreed to acquire Providence Journal Co for $1.5 billion in cash and stock.
Providence Journal shareholders would receive $12.33 in cash and 0.5333 shars of Belo series A common stock for each share of Providence Journal, the companies said late Thursday.
The deal would increase the number of Belo's total shares outstanding from 44.3 million to 69.7 million and the payment of $587 million in cash to Providence Journal holders, the companies said.
